balance_conversion.description: Fix the relationship between a `conversion` technology's outflow and consumption.

chp_backpressure_line_max.description: Set the backpressure line as a lower bound for heat generation in combined heat and power plants without extraction turbines, but with the option to divert fuel to use in direct heat generation (e.g., via a boiler). `power_to_heat_ratio` is also referred to as the `backpressure ratio` or simply `cb`.

chp_divert_fuel_to_boiler.description: Divert fuel input from use in combined heat and power generation to be used in direct heat generation (e.g., via a boiler). `boiler_eff` is the boiler efficiency. `power_to_heat_ratio` is also referred to as the `backpressure ratio` or simply `cb`.
